segments.ja201:1.1: Na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañca [babbajañca (sī.)];
segments.ja201:1.3: Sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.
segments.ja201:2.1: Etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ;
segments.ja201:2.3: Etampi chetvāna vajanti dhīrā, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāyāti.
